ZIAUR RAHMAN Full Stack Developer | React.js | Node.js | MongoDB | Microservices | 4 YOE

zrwinmail@gmail.com | +91-7595995257 | Hyderabad, India | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/zrwin | GitHub: zrwin | LeetCode: zrwin

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience designing and developing scalable web applications, microservices, and real-time enterprise platforms using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express.js, MongoDB, and AWS. Strong track record of delivering production-ready, business-critical solutions in Agile environments with expertise in CI/CD, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Argo CD.

KEY SKILLS Frontend Technologies: React.js, Next.js, Redux, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI Backend & Architecture: Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, JWT Authentication, Microservices Architecture, System Design Databases & Tools: MongoDB, SQL, Aggregation Pipelines, Query Optimization, Indexing Strategies Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD, CI/CD Pipelines, Git, Postman, Jira

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Enmovil Solutions | Full Stack Developer | Hyderabad, India | 09/2025 – Present • Developed and maintained 14+ microservices modules supporting enterprise GPS tracking, shipment visibility, courier

management, and logistics workflow automation, improving system scalability and deployment independence.

Developed RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express.js and integrated them into React.js components, improving data retrieval



efficiency and enabling dynamic UI updates. Integrated location and telemetry data from backend Flask APIs to provide end-to-end shipment visibility, including key logistics KPIs such as over speeding, night driving, geofence incursions, stoppages, and route deviations.

Built and enhanced a real-time Shipments Tracking Platform enabling operations teams to monitor and manage 5000+

shipments through interactive dashboards and map-based tracking.

Optimized MongoDB queries, aggregation pipelines, and indexing strategies, reducing API response times from 20s to 3s (~85%



improvement) and improving dashboard load performance. Supported deployment and maintenance of AWS-hosted production applications, contributing to release reliability and operational stability.

Sasken Technologies | Software Engineer | Kolkata, India | 09/2022 – 09/2025

Developed and maintained React.js applications for Caterpillar enterprise platforms including Configuration Management Modules, PLCTQ Dashboard Applications, and CAT Report Generation Systems used by global engineering teams.

Built reusable React components, custom hooks, and shared UI utilities, reducing duplicate code by approximately 30% and

improving development productivity.



Implemented Lazy Loading, Code Splitting, and route-level optimization techniques, reducing initial bundle size by approximately 45% and improving page load performance by 60–80% for large dashboard applications.

Built internal configuration management tools that automated manual engineering processes, improving team productivity by

approximately 40% and reducing configuration creation effort.

TECHNICAL PROJECTS AI-Powered Resume Builder | React.js, Tailwind CSS, Vercel, Strapi, Gemini AI API • Developed an interactive resume builder with real-time previews. Integrated Gemini AI API to dynamically generate job-specific

summaries and tailor professional experience sections based on user input.

Result Management System | Node.js, Express, MongoDB, HTML/CSS/JS, EJS • Built a full-stack educational portal for efficient data storage and result management, featuring dynamic server-side rendering

with EJS templates and a fully responsive user interface.

EDUCATION Calcutta Institute of Technology | B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) | Howrah, India | 2018 – 2022 | 8.85 CGPA

ACHIEVEMENTS & CERTIFICATIONS • • • Certifications: The Complete 2024 Web Development Bootcamp, The Complete SQL Bootcamp.

Execution Marble Award for outstanding code quality and execution on the Caterpillar enterprise project. Solved 300+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems on LeetCode and GFG.
